The signal-tier appliance (16b) is a passive listener. It receives SPAN/mirror copies of the buses, slow-telemetry from the sensor aggregators, and read-only context from SCADA; it never publishes GOOSE, never commands MMS, never trips a CB.

One time domain.
The substation PTP grandmaster disciplines both buses AND
the appliance's signal-plane clock (16b · origin_ns at ingest).
